title: Torsion cohomological dimension of a finite-type scheme
statement:
Let $K$ be a field with $\operatorname{cd}_{\rm tor}(K)\leq c$,
and let $X$ be a finite-type
$K$-scheme of dimension $d$.
Then $\operatorname{cd}_{\rm tor}(X)\leq2d+c$, in the sense of
[def-sc-etale-torsion-cd].

proof.text: Convert the field bound from derived-category cohomology to Sheaf.H using Functor.homologyRightDerivedFunctorObjSingleFunctorIso, Sheaf.ΓNatIsoSheafSections, NatIso.rightDerived, and Sheaf.subsingleton_H_iff_isZero_rightDerived. These are the existing general global-sections comparison isomorphisms; vanishing transports in either direction.
Apply the affine-to-global Leray reduction, supplying the affine finite-type calculation with the converted field bound.
Transport the resulting Sheaf.H vanishing back to derived-category cohomology along the same general global-sections comparison isomorphisms.
